requirements.text: Our client, a leader in fintech, is seeking a contract Data Scientist. This is s hybrid role Tue - Thu onsite in San Francisco. The rest is remote
as a data scientist, must be strong in SQL and Python - to build and deploy ML models - risk models, churn, models, response models - advanced data analytics
5+ years’ experience in analytics/data science roles directly informing product decisions; bachelor’s degree or higher in a quantitative field (or equivalent experience).
5+ years’ experience in analytics/data science roles directly informing product decisions; bachelor’s degree or higher in a quantitative field (or equivalent experience).
Strong background in statistics and experimentation (hypothesis testing, causal inference, design), able to explain and apply meaningful metrics.
Fluent in SQL and at least one scripting/statistical language (Python or R); comfortable with data engineering and pipeline development.
Skilled at building and evaluating statistical/ML models, balancing complexity and practicality.
Apply Model Context Protocol (MCP) standards to ensure transparency, context-awareness, and regulatory compliance in model development, deployment, and monitoring.
Use AI tooling to accelerate analysis and documentation while applying human judgment before making recommendations.
Strong critical thinking, with a consultative approach to problem-solving and stakeholder management.
High standards for measurement accuracy; able to flex communication to technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience in fintech, consumer lending, or related financial services
Familiarity with CDP platforms, event instrumentation, or experimentation tools
Direct experience with credit or risk modeling, pricing, or marketing decisioning
Hands-on with dbt, Airflow, or similar data pipeline/orchestration tools
Prior experience embedded with product teams in agile environments
